review.notes: All 42 physical pages were compared against the extracted PDF text with normalized n-gram matching, and every patched location was verified on rendered pages (footnote blocks at 200 dpi, the SpaceXAI sentence and reference interpunct separators as 300-500 dpi crops, visually read). No code fences exist in this OCR. Dropped chart-source footnote bodies, the two intro footnotes, the title revision line, eleven dropped chart axis-title captions and thirteen glued reference separators are restored; the Cursor dagger marker and the SpaceXAI spacing are corrected. The OCR's escaped-hyphen bullet glyphs ('\-' where the PDF prints '•') were left unchanged, matching the accepted grok-4-7-model-card cleanup.

unresolved.evidence: The CursorBench scatter charts ('Score vs tokens', 'Score vs cost') keep their axis labels, values and legends as figure-internal text; the OCR captured no axis text for these two embeds. Restoring the full axis anatomy is not a caption-level repair and is covered by the embedded images.
